cards.title: Post-Quantum Secure Blockchain-Based Federated Learning Framework for Healthcare Analytics
cards.authors: Daniel Commey, Sena G. Hounsinou, Garth V. Crosby
cards.tldr: The growth of IoT in healthcare generates massive sensitive data. We evaluate three signature-based PQC algorithms—Falcon, Dilithium (ML-DSA-65), and SPHINCS+ (SPHINCS+-SHA2-128s)—to assess their impact on blockchain transaction costs and latency.
